headline: US Democrats push to restrict war funding and block new strikes on Iran
label: NEWS
caption:
US Democrats are using an upcoming government funding deadline to pressure the White House into ending the war.

According to Al Jazeera, federal funding is set to expire on December 11, and legislators are negotiating a bipartisan agreement to keep agencies running.

Representatives Yassamin Ansari and Ro Khanna stated that Congress must use its power of the purse to prohibit funds from being used for offensive operations in Iran.

Analyst Andreas Krieg noted that the bill could serve as the first serious institutional constraint on presidential war powers, though Trump still retains executive veto authority.

Polls from Reuters and Ipsos show that 71 percent of Americans want the new Congress to end the conflict.
